message.content:
Based on the image provided, here are the answers to your questions:

**(1) The Info Box:**
Yes, there is a dark brown (semi-transparent looking), rounded rectangular info box in the upper-left area. It contains the text:
*   **Header:** "HOW TO ORDER" (in bold yellow/gold text)
*   **List:**
    1.  Pick a meal time
    2.  Tap a category to expand
    3.  Tap again to select

**(2) The Left Column (Foods):**
It shows **ONE big meal card** that is currently expanded.
*   **Meal Name:** The card header displays "**Breakfast**" with a sunrise icon and a badge saying "6 items".
*   **Content Inside:** The card lists the specific food items vertically with prices on the right (e.g., Firfir - 80 Br, Fatira - 60 Br, Chechebsa - 70 Br, etc.).

**(3) The Right Column (Drinks):**
Yes, along the right edge of the screen, there is a vertical column containing **7 small, white, rounded-rectangular pills** (category buttons). Each pill has an icon on the left and text starting with "Ca..." (likely categories like Coffee, Cappuccino, etc.).

**(4) The Chef/Owner:**
Yes, the chef is clearly visible in the **lower-left area** of the screen. She appears to be a woman wearing a traditional white chef's hat (toque), a red headscarf, a white chef's jacket, and a beige apron. She is smiling and gesturing with her hands open/palms up towards the menu.
